items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies
An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code, Codex and other agents as an AI collaborator in your vault.
Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
An open-source, cross OS, community-driven launcher. A lightweight alternative to Spotlight and Raycast. Made with ❤️ from Viet Nam 🇻🇳
Kition: the open pro suite for AI. Notes, tables, boards and professional editors in one desktop workspace, edited by you and your agent
Ever® Teams™ - The Workplace for Humans. Open Work & Productivity Platform - https://ever.team

Open-source AI Agent for iOS, iPadOS and Android, designed primarily for iPadOS. On-device Linux, 3D/CAD, Notes, Office, Canvas, Python/Node.js, terminal, Git, voice and Skill Hub. BYOK AI; supported local models and native 3D editing on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 工作台，以 iPadOS 体验为核心。
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
Microsoft Office Pro 2026 desktop setup with document authoring, spreadsheet engine and presentation assembly bundled into one offline x64 package for Windows 11.

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.
A fast, native scrollable-tiling window manager for macOS, inspired by Niri.

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.

Aetox harness: a local-first Windows AI environment - model, skills, team and memory as one system. Two doors - an Assistant that adapts to your work and drives a real browser; and a Developer that names each weakness before writing, checks the project's security, runs the project's tests before saying done, and remembers what this project decided.

Self-hosted AI workspace with agents, skills, and tools (Gmail, Calendar) that runs entirely on your own provider API keys (BYOK). Bring your own keys — Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Google AI.
